title: United Arab Emirates: Midday Break
text: The UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation runs an annual Midday Break rule: from 15 June to 15 September, work under direct sun and in open air is not allowed between 12:30 and 15:00. Employers must provide shaded rest areas, drinking water, and rehydration supplies during the break. This is a national labour rule, separate from Qatar's, and Harara does not compute against it; the exact ministerial resolution text is not held in Harara's rule store.
source: UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, Midday Break rule (annual ministerial resolution)
